description: When Xal says "It is done." and the region changes, music stays on the current theme until the player opens Outlook. Opening Outlook, including by tapping the current tab again, then plays that region's track. This is intentional.
steps: Play through a scene until Xal says "It is done." and the region changes
Confirm the outlook picture updates while the current theme keeps playing
Open Outlook by tapping the Outlook button
Confirm the new region's music starts
Repeat the scene change, then open Outlook by tapping the current tab again
Confirm the new region's music starts the same way

description: The first time the player is ready to go from level 1 to level 2, a finger points at the level chip until they open the level-up splash. Later level-ups only show the exclamation mark.
steps: Reach a full experience bar while still level 1
Confirm a finger points up at the level chip next to the exclamation mark
Tap the chip and confirm the level-up splash opens and the finger hides
Collect the reward and confirm the finger does not return on later level-ups

description: The blessing is offered once per level, after 200 casts or creature taps. Reaching that count does not open the splash. Leveling up allows the offer again.
steps: Cast or tap creatures until the count reaches 200 this level
Confirm the Sky's Grace splash does not open
Confirm another 200 taps this level do not start a second offer
Level up, then reach 200 taps again
Confirm the offer can happen again on the new level

description: While a blessing is offered, a Pegasus flies across the screen. If it is not tapped, it comes back from the other direction and keeps alternating until the player taps it. Tapping it opens the Sky's Grace splash.
steps: Reach a blessing offer
Confirm a Pegasus flies across the screen
Let it leave without tapping
Confirm it returns from the opposite direction
Confirm it keeps alternating directions until tapped
Tap the Pegasus and confirm the Sky's Grace splash opens

description: After the Pegasus flies off one side, it waits about 10 seconds, then flies back from the other side. Leaving Outlook pauses that wait.
steps: Reach a blessing offer and let the Pegasus fly off the screen
Confirm it stays gone for about 10 seconds
Confirm it then flies back from the opposite direction
Leave Outlook during a wait
Confirm the next pass does not start until you are back on Outlook

description: The first time the player has never collected the blessing, a pointer sits just under the flying Pegasus. After they have collected it once, later Pegasus flybys have no pointer.
steps: On a save that has never collected the blessing, reach an offer
Confirm a pointer sits just under the Pegasus while it flies
Collect the blessing
On a later level, reach another offer
Confirm the Pegasus flies with no pointer

description: Collect on the Sky's Grace splash starts 15 seconds of infinite mana. The mana bar is replaced by a countdown for those seconds.
steps: Open the Sky's Grace splash by tapping the Pegasus
Tap Collect
Confirm casts no longer spend mana
Confirm the mana bar shows a countdown from 15s down to 1s
Confirm the mana bar returns when the countdown ends

description: During the tutorial, tapping the Xal button in the bottom nav while already on the Xal view stays on that view. On the last tutorial step, the Outlook button is still the way to leave.
steps: Start a new game and stay on the Xal view during the tutorial
Tap the Xal button in the bottom nav
Confirm the Xal view stays open and Outlook does not appear
Finish the tutorial dialogue until the pointer aims at the Outlook button
Tap the Outlook button and confirm Outlook opens

description: After the tutorial, tapping the current bottom-nav tab again opens Outlook.
steps: Finish the tutorial
Open the Xal view, then tap the Xal button again
Confirm that second tap opens Outlook

description: During the tutorial, Settings stays lit and opens. Rewards stays locked.
steps: Start a new game and confirm Settings opens
Confirm Rewards stays dim and does not open
Reach the tome step, then the step where the pointer aims at Outlook
Confirm Settings still opens and Rewards still does not

description: Opening Settings during the tutorial does not advance Xal's line. Returning to Xal shows that same line.
steps: Finish Chapter 1 so a tutorial line is showing
Open Settings, then return to the Xal view
Confirm the same line is showing and the tutorial has not moved on

description: During the tutorial, tapping Settings while it is already open returns to the screen they came from. It does not open Outlook.
steps: On the Xal view, open Settings, then tap Settings again
Confirm the Xal view returns and Outlook does not open
On the Tomes view during the tome step, open Settings, then tap Settings again
Confirm the Tomes view returns and Outlook does not open
While the pointer aims at Outlook, open Settings from the Xal view, then tap Settings again
Confirm the Xal view returns and the tutorial does not finish

description: While Settings is open during the tutorial, the finger points at the nav button for the step they left, not at Settings.
steps: Open Settings during tutorial dialogue on Xal
Confirm the finger points at the Xal button
Open Settings from Tomes while the tutorial is waiting on the Nature tome
Confirm the finger points at the Tomes button
Open Settings while the pointer aims at Outlook
Confirm the finger points at the Outlook button

description: Barlog only shows on Outlook while chapter 6, Returning Home, is playing.
steps: Open Outlook when Returning Home is the next chapter and confirm Barlog appears
Finish that chapter and confirm he leaves
Confirm he does not appear during the tutorial or on any other chapter

description: Buying the first copy of a tome plays a lock rattle while the lock shakes, a shatter when it breaks, and a chime when the creature card appears. Closing the splash early stops the later sounds.
steps: Buy a tome you do not own yet
Confirm a rattle plays as the lock shakes, around 1 second and again around 1.4 seconds
Confirm a shatter plays as the lock breaks, around 2 seconds
Confirm a chime plays as the creature card appears, around 3 seconds
Buy another first tome and close the splash during the lock shake
Confirm the later sounds do not play

description: The first time each special creature variant (Corrupted, Golden, Unstable, Phantom, Leech) visibly enters Outlook, a unified First-Encounter Modal pauses Outlook and introduces it once per save. Legacy saves without seenVariants pre-mark Corrupted at level 2+ and Golden at level 11+.
steps: On a fresh save or level 12, 15, or 17 jump, watch a new creature variant enter Outlook
Confirm the First-Encounter Modal opens with an animated variant preview and pauses creatures and timers
Dismiss the modal and confirm Outlook resumes and the same variant modal does not open again on later spawns
Load a legacy save missing seenVariants at level 2+ or 11+ and confirm Corrupted (2+) and Golden (11+) are pre-marked while Unstable, Phantom, and Leech remain unseen

description: Outlook uses split-slot variant spawning: at most one Classic variant (Corrupted or Golden) and at most one Frenzy threat (Unstable, Phantom, or Leech) active at once, with 28%/32%/38% Frenzy roll by level (12/15/17), an 8.5s backup timer, Y-lane separation between active specials, and mobile hitbox fairness for Unstable.
steps: Play on Outlook at levels 12, 15, and 17+
Confirm at most one Classic variant and one Frenzy threat are active simultaneously
Confirm a Frenzy threat spawns within 8.5 seconds of Outlook play when none is active
Confirm simultaneous special variants spawn in separated vertical lanes and Unstable sits below other creatures with a tighter tap radius and 0.6s spawn grace

description: Unstable Creature (level 12+) ignores Arcane Surge and Triad Burst secondary arcs. Direct tap after spawn grace detonates it and triggers a 5s Mana-Lock, while planting a ground spell flower ahead of it traps it and triggers Wild Frenzy.
steps: Encounter an Unstable Creature at level 12+
Trigger Arcane Surge and confirm it does not detonate or zap the Unstable Creature
Tap the ground ahead of an Unstable Creature to plant a spell flower and confirm walking over it traps the creature and sparks Wild Frenzy
Directly tap another Unstable Creature after 0.6s and confirm it detonates and triggers a 5s Mana-Lock

description: Phantom Creature (level 15+) ignores Arcane Surge, Triad Burst secondary arcs, and spell flowers. It cycles between solid and faded states: 2 solid taps clear it for Wild Frenzy, while tapping it while faded triggers a 3s Mana-Lock without cracking its shields.
steps: Encounter a Phantom Creature at level 15+ and observe it cycling between solid and faded
Confirm Arcane Surge and spell flowers do not affect it
Tap it while faded and confirm a 3s Mana-Lock triggers and its shield count does not drop
Tap it twice while solid and confirm it clears, glows, and adds a Wild Frenzy stack

description: Leech (level 17+) runs quickly, absorbs Arcane Surge without taking damage, eats spell flowers without taking damage, snuffs nearby glowing creatures, and drains Wild Frenzy at double speed. Two quick direct taps stop it and grant +2 Wild Frenzy stacks.
steps: Encounter a Leech at level 17+ while glowing creatures and Wild Frenzy are active
Confirm Arcane Surge draws a teal deflect arc and spell flowers are eaten without harming the Leech
Confirm the Leech snuffs glowing creatures and accelerates Wild Frenzy drain
Tap the Leech twice and confirm it clears and grants +2 Wild Frenzy stacks

description: Wild Frenzy stacks across 2x, 3x, 5x, and 8x for 12 seconds, multiplying all live Influence and XP (casts, creature taps, resonance, passive per-second rate) while excluding offline rewards, level-up rewards, and achievement payouts, and pausing while modals are open.
steps: Clear or trap Frenzy threats in succession and confirm the Wild Frenzy bar stacks 2x, 3x, 5x, up to 8x and refreshes to 12s
Confirm live casts, glowing ticks, and the HUD per-second rate reflect the Wild Frenzy multiplier
Confirm offline, level-up, and achievement rewards still use the base passive rate
Open a modal while Wild Frenzy is active and confirm its timer pauses until the modal closes

description: Mana-Lock shows a crimson LOCKED countdown in the mana slot identically in normal play and during Sky's Grace, clears combo, reduces casts to unempowered 1x without spending mana, drops 1 Wild Frenzy stack, and resumes Sky's Grace automatically if time remains after the lock expires.
steps: Trigger Mana-Lock in normal play and confirm mana empties, combo resets, casts deal 1x, 1 Wild Frenzy stack drops, and the mana slot displays crimson LOCKED Xs
Activate Sky's Grace and trigger Mana-Lock during it
Confirm the same crimson LOCKED Xs countdown replaces the Sky's Grace timer and casts deal 1x without spending stored mana
Wait for Mana-Lock to end while Sky's Grace still has time left and confirm Sky's Grace free 5x casting resumes
